findings.evidence: `DixonDef.lean:65-66` defines `dixonH2` using `f (γ t) / (γ t - w) * deriv γ t`, and `DixonDef.lean:93-96` already phrases the Dixon identity with `h_cauchy_int` on that actual integrand; the nearby public winding API likewise uses the pointwise integrand assumption at `WindingContinuity.lean:116-119` rather than exposing the stronger sufficient `deriv γ` hypothesis.
findings.fix: State the general theorem with `h_int : IntervalIntegrable (fun t ↦ f (γ t) / (γ t - w) * deriv γ t) volume a b` (or equivalently the numerator product), derive the present continuity/integrable-derivative version as a corollary if desired.
findings.issue: `dixonH2_differentiableAt` requires `ContinuousOn f (γ '' uIcc a b)` and `IntervalIntegrable (deriv γ)`, although differentiating the Cauchy kernel only needs integrability of the actual `dixonH2` integrand at `w`.

summary: The theorem proves the right local differentiability result, but its public hypotheses are stronger than the natural integral-level API used nearby.
